title: Impact Vignettes & Metrics Pocketbook
content:
Purpose: compact, portable set of short impact stories + metrics I can drop into 1:1s, calibration, and promotion discussions. Use these as the first 90s of any ask; practice framing and one-line outcome.

How to use: pick 1 vignette, 1 metric, 1 ask. If asked to expand, use the 'what I did / why it mattered / measurable result' template. Keep the narrative tight (30–45s).

Vignettes (short form) — practice lines first: 
1) Cross-team onboarding kit revamp
- What I did: led small cross-functional sprint to rewrite onboarding checklist, removed duplicate steps between infra & security, created two templated playbooks.
- Why it mattered: reduced average ramp time for new perm hires and contractors in infra-adj teams.
- Result: median time-to-first-merge dropped from 12 days -> 6 days over 3 months (sample n=18). Slack shoutout from Platform ENG (Mar 2026).

Practice line: "I ran a focused playbook rewrite that halved time-to-first-merge for infra-adj hires — reduced blocker flow and lowered onboarding support load."

2) Pilot: manager enablement huddle series
- What I did: designed and facilitated 4-week micro-huddle on calibration language + coaching prompts for first-time managers, mixed async kit + 45m live labs.
- Why it mattered: improved confidence & consistency in calibration inputs.
- Result: post-pilot survey (n=22) showed 82% higher self-reported calibration confidence; calibration meeting length dropped ~15% as fewer clarifying Qs were needed.

Practice line: "I designed a short live+async enablement that made calibration inputs clearer and faster, proven by survey + reduced meeting time."

3) Offboarding checklist automation
- What I did: automated access revocation + exit survey reminders; integrated with SSO and HR ticketing.
- Why it mattered: lowered security exposure and improved trend data for attrition drivers.
- Result: mean manual revocation tasks dropped 75% in month following rollout; exit survey completion rate up from 28% -> 64%.

Practice line: "I automated offboarding steps so security work moved from manual to fully automated, and exit feedback capture doubled."

Quant metrics to pull quickly (placeholder values — swap with live dashboard numbers before meeting):
- Hiring cycle time (offer->start): 28 days (target 24).
- Time-to-productivity (first productive PR): median 6 days.
- Manager enablement NPS (pilot): +24.
- HR ticket backlog (priority): 4 open (down from 11).
- Cost of contractor onboarding (approx): $X per head — note to pull from growth sheet.

Quick asks (tiered):
- Small (ask for 1:1): time to unblock a runway decision (e.g., approve template or budget).
- Medium (ask for manager): trial headcount for a 1-2 month contractor to cover immediate capacity risk (include rough cost).
- Stretch (skip if no bandwidth): expand pilot manager enablement to another org area with 6-week rollout.

Conversation cues & risk signals (one-liners):
- "I want to reduce day-1 confusion for new joiners — quick fix checklist is ready, need greenlight to push to infra owners."
- "We see a recurring pattern in offboarding that suggests exit feedback is biased — want to run deeper 1:1s with departing senior ICs."
- Risk: if we delay automation, we have manual security overhead and missed exit feedback windows during hiring surge.

Calibration prep snippets (for exec/manager sync):
- "Calibration inputs: focused on evidence from surveys + ticket metrics; I pushed to standardize the rubric which reduced variance in scoring."
- "Bias check: I anonymized pilot inputs to confirm consistent trending across teams before raising signals."

Notes-to-self / rehearsal prompts (short):
- Open with outcome, then my action, then ask. Example: "Halved onboarding time (outcome) by rewriting playbooks (action). Would like 2 additional hours of engineering time to implement templates company-wide (ask)."
- Keep the ask narrow and time-boxed (easier to say yes).
- When manager pushes back: offer a 30-day pilot + success metrics commitment.

To-dos before next 1:1: 
- Replace placeholder metrics with live numbers from "hiring-analytics" sheet (pull before Friday).
- Link the offboarding automation runbook to the Confluence page (CONFLUENCE-PO-1789).
- Draft a 30-day pilot plan for manager enablement expansion (2 slides + success metrics).

Open questions / friction points I want manager input on: 
- Priority: dedicate engineering FTE vs contract for playbook rollout? Pros/cons and cost expectation.
- Timing: any upcoming org changes that would make rollout messy?
- Sponsorship: who is the cross-functional sponsor we should loop in?

Raw snippets to copy into 1:1: 
- "Quick wins: halved time-to-first-merge; freed ~8hrs/week of onboarding support. Request: 2 weeks of SWE time to standardize templates.
- "Pilot success: manager enablement raised self-reported calibration confidence by 82% — want to scale with minimal overhead."

Archive & version notes: keep this file as the pocketbook for rehearsal lines. After each 1:1, append date + one-sentence outcome to the log on the right (or a separate sheet).

Unresolved: need to confirm cost figure for contractor ask (see JIRA-5021).

End of pocketbook.

-- Lina
(quick personal tag: breathe, keep it simple, prioritize one impactful ask)
